items.gloss: 自分の拳を突き上げる
items.source_sentence: At that news, your wallet pumps its fist
When you see a price tag that makes you want to say, "Haven't you heard the news?", it seems there is a time lag

items.gloss: 値上がりの背景にある
items.source_sentence: One cafe operator in Chicago said that the cost of cups and labor, as well as the cost of buying beans, had been behind price increases

1.text: to raise a closed hand to show excitement or victory

2.text: a delay between something happening and its effect being seen

3.text: helping to cause prices to go up
